claims.claim: Explicit typed feedback preparation remains owned by RuntimeCompletion and authenticates current native admission, candidate, latest checkpoint history, reviewed mapping and original proof captures.

Actionable feedback requires complete stable native candidate FAIL. Per-proof outcomes, original evidence identities, all mapped obligations and exact affected/outstanding acceptance remain visible, including independent integration and worker PASS obligations with ordering and repetition conditions.

The closed bounded factual schema preserves exact binding and admitted Executor context, excludes raw instructions and implementation advice, and explicitly denies delivery, continuation, dispatch and production authority.

Immutable replay retains original bytes without proof execution or resource debit. Missing native captures now raise a bounded contract error while retaining the mutation fence and partial capture. Competing feedback and FAILURE attempts remain excluded by the existing fence.
REPAIR and REMEDIATION feedback remain explicitly BLOCKED with correction native authority not established; PRIMARY-shaped witnesses confer no correction authority.

Real-Git/native conformance tests remain intact. The shared-population fixture preserves independent proofs, and contention checks start at the held write fence without timeout inflation or weakened assertions. Changes are confined to two approved paths; existing documentation retains the unactivated seam and explicit downstream obligations.
